related.title: SPDX：元件關係圖與SBOM完整性
related.titleEn: SPDX: relationship graphs and SBOM completeness
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付40項元件表、8項適用性理由、遞移依賴路徑與更新後回歸結果。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver forty inventory rows, eight applicability decisions, transitive paths and post-update regression results.
related.difference: 區分檔案、套件、文件與關係識別碼，檢查每條關係端點是否存在並追到發布主體。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish files, packages, documents and relationship identifiers; validate endpoints and trace each component to the release subject.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 受影響元件比例=符合公告範圍的唯一元件/盤點元件；公告數不等於受影響部署數。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 鎖定檔有40個唯一元件，8個落在合成公告範圍，其中3個是直接依賴、5個是遞移依賴。 受影響比例=8/40=20%；需追蹤5條遞移修復路徑。
圖完整性=端點均可解析的關係數/全部關係；欄位存在不保證內容真實。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成SBOM有25個元件與30條關係，3條引用不存在的元件。 可解析關係27/30=90%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Affected-component fraction counts unique matching components, not advisories or deployed instances. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A lockfile contains forty unique components; eight match synthetic ranges, comprising three direct and five transitive dependencies. Affected fraction=8/40=20%; five transitive remediation paths need tracing.

Graph integrity is resolvable relationships divided by all relationships; populated fields do not prove truthful content. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic SBOM contains twenty-five components and thirty relationships; three reference absent components. Resolvable relationship fraction=27/30=90%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GitHub Actions：工作權限與不可信輸入隔離
related.titleEn: GitHub Actions: job permissions and untrusted-input boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付40項元件表、8項適用性理由、遞移依賴路徑與更新後回歸結果。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver forty inventory rows, eight applicability decisions, transitive paths and post-update regression results.
related.difference: 把事件來源、程式信任程度、token權限與密鑰可見性畫成矩陣，分開測試與發布工作。
related.differenceEn: Map event source, code trust, token permissions and secret visibility; separate test jobs from release jobs.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 受影響元件比例=符合公告範圍的唯一元件/盤點元件；公告數不等於受影響部署數。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 鎖定檔有40個唯一元件，8個落在合成公告範圍，其中3個是直接依賴、5個是遞移依賴。 受影響比例=8/40=20%；需追蹤5條遞移修復路徑。
最小權限縮減率=(原授權動作數−必要動作數)/原授權動作數；動作數僅是教學代理量。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 三個測試工作各被授8種動作，實際各需2種唯讀動作；發布工作另行評估。 測試工作授權由24降6，縮減18/24=75%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Affected-component fraction counts unique matching components, not advisories or deployed instances. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A lockfile contains forty unique components; eight match synthetic ranges, comprising three direct and five transitive dependencies. Affected fraction=8/40=20%; five transitive remediation paths need tracing.

Permission reduction=(original actions−required actions)/original actions; action count is only a teaching proxy. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Three test jobs each receive eight action permissions but need only two read-only actions; assess release separately. Test-job grants shrink from twenty-four to six, a 75% reduction.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
